name.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for a staff member's name.

role.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for a staff member's role: pastor, elder or staff.

photo.description: The label of the field for the address of a staff member's photo.

email.description: The label of the field for a staff member's email address.

phone.description: The label of the field for a staff member's phone number.

bio.description: The label of the rich text editor for a staff member's bio in full.

photoUpload.description: The accessible name of the badge on a staff member's picture that picks an image to upload as their photo, when they have none.

photoChange.description: The accessible name of the badge on a staff member's picture that picks an image to upload in place of their photo.

photoUploading.description: The accessible name of the upload badge while a staff member's photo is being uploaded.

photoRemove.description: The accessible name of the badge on a staff member's picture that removes their photo.

photoRemoving.description: The accessible name of the remove badge while a staff member's photo is being removed.

photoConfirm.description: The question asked before a staff member's photo is removed. `name` is the member's name.

photoInvalid.defaultMessage: That file can’t be used. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image of 4 MB or less.
photoInvalid.description: The error shown when the file picked for a staff member's photo is not an image of an accepted kind, or is too large.

bioEmpty.description: What stands in for a staff member's bio when they have none: an invitation to click and start writing.
